easy.q: What did President Oaks invite us to do with the talks of this conference?
options: Study them, ponder them prayerfully, and act on them
Put them away until the next conference comes
Pick one favorite and learn it word for word
easy.why: President Oaks said, “we invite all to study and ponder them prayerfully and to act in faith on the principles they explain.” Conference is meant to be lived, not just heard.

easy.q: President Oaks said the world is being welcomed to a special event. What is it?
options: A youth music festival on Temple Square
The Salt Lake Temple Celebration
The groundbreaking for a new temple
easy.why: He said, “we are welcoming the world, in person or virtually, to the Salt Lake Temple Celebration.”

easy.q: What is Dedicate, which President Oaks said would begin right after the session?
options: A new book of hymns
A magazine for children
A video series
easy.why: President Oaks called Dedicate “a dynamic video series” and said its first episode would premiere worldwide after the session.

easy.q: As he closed, what blessings did President Oaks invoke on us and our families?
options: Riches and success
Peace and contentment
Health and long life
easy.why: He said, “we invoke the blessings of the Lord on you and your families, blessings of peace and contentment.”

easy.q: President Oaks said this conference helped us unite our testimonies on whose teachings?
options: The Lord Jesus Christ
The early pioneers
The prophet Moses
easy.why: He said the conference inspired us to unite our testimonies “on the teachings of the Lord Jesus Christ” and His Father’s plan.

medium.q: President Oaks quoted the Lord’s promise, “Unto him that receiveth I will give more.” What did he use it to show?
options: Those who give generously will be repaid with wealth
More conference talks will be published each year
Those who study and act on these messages will be given more
Those who visit the temple will receive more callings
medium.why: The promise comes right after his invitation to study, ponder, and act on the talks. Receiving what the Lord has given at conference opens the way for Him to give more.

medium.q: What do President Oaks’s words about the Salt Lake Temple Celebration show about who is invited to it?
options: Members who hold a current temple recommend
The public, for the world is being welcomed
Leaders and guests who are specially invited
Families who live near enough to Temple Square
medium.why: He said “we are welcoming the world, in person or virtually,” and that “the temple doors will open to the public.” The invitation reaches far beyond our own members.

medium.q: According to President Oaks, what is Heavenly Father’s plan for?
options: Our comfort and ease in this life
Our worldly success and renown
Our freedom from every duty
Our eternal increase and joy
medium.why: President Oaks spoke of the Father’s “plan for our eternal increase and joy.” The plan looks far beyond this life and is meant for our happiness.

medium.q: Besides invoking the Lord’s blessings on us and our families, what did President Oaks say he blesses?
options: Our service of the Lord Jesus Christ
Our safe travel home from conference
Our plans to visit Temple Square
Our efforts to share the video series
medium.why: He said, “we bless your service of the Lord Jesus Christ in these challenging times.” His blessing was on what we do for the Savior.

medium.q: President Oaks said more would come in the months ahead, including a virtual tour of the Salt Lake Temple. How does that fit the way he said the world is being welcomed?
options: It is prepared mainly for members who live in Utah
It is offered once the celebration itself has ended
It lets people take part who cannot come in person
It takes the place of visiting the temple in person
medium.why: He said the world is welcomed “in person or virtually.” A video series premiering “worldwide in multiple languages” and a virtual tour open the celebration to those far away.

hard.q: Which person’s search best fits what President Oaks testified is to be found in the restored Church of Jesus Christ?
options: One seeking what the Lord taught and the covenant path to follow
One seeking a way to be free of every challenge in this life
One seeking answers to every question that science has raised
One seeking proof so strong that faith is no longer needed
hard.why: He testified, “Truth is to be found here—truth about the teachings of the Lord and truth about the covenant path that will lead us to our destiny.”

hard.q: How did President Oaks describe the destiny to which the covenant path leads?
options: The destiny each of us designs for ourselves
The destiny earned by years of Church service
The destiny foretold in a patriarchal blessing
The destiny desired by our Heavenly Father
hard.why: He called it “the destiny desired by our Heavenly Father.” The covenant path leads to what a loving Father wants for His children.

hard.q: Which family best follows the full invitation President Oaks gave about the conference talks?
options: They replay the talks in the background while doing chores
They read a talk, pray about it, and choose a principle to live
They copy favorite lines from the talks to hang on the wall
They read every talk quickly in the first week to finish them
hard.why: The invitation has three parts: study, ponder prayerfully, and “act in faith on the principles they explain.” Hearing or collecting the words is only a beginning.

hard.q: According to President Oaks, what makes the opening of the Salt Lake Temple doors on April 5, 2027, historic?
options: The temple has never before been open to anyone
It is the first temple ever opened to the public
It is the first such public opening since 1893
It marks 134 years since the Church was organized
hard.why: He said the doors will open to the public, “the first such opening since 1893, 134 years ago.” The 134 years count from that earlier opening.

hard.q: President Oaks’s first sentence and his closing testimony each join the same two things. Which pair is it?
options: What the prophets foretold, and how it is now being fulfilled
What the temple offers, and how the world is being welcomed
What we are asked to do, and the blessings promised in return
What the Lord taught, and what our Father intends for us
hard.why: He opened with “the teachings of the Lord Jesus Christ and His Father’s plan for our eternal increase and joy,” and closed testifying of truth about the Lord’s teachings and the path to “the destiny desired by our Heavenly Father.”
